decision: Reject. 35987 passes every hard rule (no face, no text, feet only, outdoor steps, daylight, continuous descent for 3.2s) but its stiletto-and-handbag wardrobe is unmistakable fashion-stock and contradicts the walker already established in f04 (dark jeans, brown suede shoes); the f03 verifier rejected this identical clip for the same reason and f17 is its pair. Nothing else in the candidates folder is stairs + faceless + single walker for 3.2s. Use the same card fallback as f03, or drop the f17 stairs beat and let f04's sidewalk walk carry the outdoor movement.
fallback: cream paper card (match f03), or cut the beat
